name: SimpleHedgePanel
summary: This is a hedging panel utility EA that provides a graphical interface for managing hedge positions. It delegates all logic to the CHedgePanel class and serves as a thin wrapper handling initialization, deinitialization, and chart events.
summary_zh: 这是一个对冲面板工具型EA，提供图形界面来管理对冲仓位。所有逻辑委托给CHedgePanel类，本身仅作为初始化、反初始化和图表事件的轻量封装。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个对冲管理面板工具，本身不自动产生交易信号或开仓，而是依赖用户通过面板界面手动或半自动操作。策略概念围绕对冲交易设计，允许用户同时持有多空仓位以降低方向性风险。入场条件和出场条件完全由用户通过面板交互决定，EA不包含自动入场或出场逻辑。仓位管理方面，用户通过InpBoxes参数设定盒子数量（默认3个），可能用于分组管理不同对冲组合。资金管理方面，该EA没有内置的资金管理规则，所有风险控制依赖于用户的手动判断和操作。整体而言，这是一个交互式工具而非自动化交易策略。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a hedging management panel utility that does not automatically generate trading signals or open positions; instead, it relies on user interaction through the panel interface for manual or semi-automated operation. The strategy concept revolves around hedging, allowing users to hold both long and short positions simultaneously to reduce directional risk. Entry and exit conditions are entirely determined by the user through panel interaction, with the EA containing no automatic entry or exit logic. For position management, the user configures the number of boxes via the InpBoxes parameter (default 3), which likely groups different hedge combinations. Money management is absent from the EA itself, with all risk control depending on the user's manual judgment and operations. Overall, this is an interactive tool rather than an automated trading strategy.

parameters.name: InpBoxes
parameters.description: 对冲盒子数量，用于分组管理对冲仓位组合
parameters.description_en: Number of hedge boxes for grouping hedge positions

pros: 提供图形化面板界面，操作直观便捷
对冲交易模式可有效降低单边方向性风险
代码结构清晰，将面板逻辑封装在独立类中便于维护
pros_en: Provides a graphical panel interface for intuitive and convenient operation
Hedging trading mode can effectively reduce unilateral directional risk
Clean code structure with panel logic encapsulated in a separate class for maintainability
cons: 依赖外部头文件HedgePanel.mqh，核心逻辑不可见导致难以评估完整性
缺少自动风控机制，完全依赖用户手动管理风险
无可编程止损止盈或资金管理参数，功能扩展性有限
cons_en: Depends on external include file HedgePanel.mqh, making core logic invisible and hard to assess completeness
Lacks automatic risk control mechanisms, relying entirely on manual user risk management
No programmable stop-loss/take-profit or money management parameters, limiting extensibility
improvements: 增加内置风险控制参数如最大持仓和止损设置，减少用户操作失误风险
将面板配置持久化到图表或文件中，避免重启后设置丢失
improvements_en: Add built-in risk control parameters such as maximum positions and stop-loss settings to reduce user error risk
Persist panel configuration to chart or file to prevent settings loss after restart

risk_points: 对冲面板本身不自动开仓，风险主要来自用户操作不当
缺少程序化止损机制，极端行情下用户可能无法及时手动平仓
risk_points_en: The panel itself does not auto-open positions; risk mainly comes from improper user operation
Lack of programmatic stop-loss means users may not close positions in time during extreme market conditions
